_comment: Topics inside each category. A reference gets the first topic whose tags match its Pixabay tags (or the --topic given to `pnpm refs fetch`, or a reviewer's choice). Order matters: more specific topics first. `queries` are Pixabay searches; `sourceQueries` holds searches for the other picture sources (openverse, artic, met, pexels). A source is used for a topic only if the topic has queries for it.

_sorting._comment: Picture sorter (ADR-0009): a local CLIP model matches each reference picture against these prompts and the topics' `prompts`. Used only to sort reference pictures, never to grade or critique drawings. A topic is the mean of its prompts. Style: reject if the category's allowed styles get less than minStyle. Topic: compared with every topic of every category in the same group; re-file if the best beats the own topic by margin and has at least minBest, reject if the own topic has less than rejectBelow, otherwise keep. Subject: see `subject`. Categories not listed here (fundamentals) are not checked. Changing anything here makes ref-service re-check its whole pool once on the next start.

photo: a high quality photo of a real thing

subject._comment: One drawable subject: a reference must show one clear subject (topic "subject": "single", the default) or one coherent scene ("scene"), not a sheet, grid, icon set, pattern, text or logo. Checked on the topic a picture ends up in. Keep class = mean of the topic's prompts and its kind's prompts; it competes with every `reject` class and every prompt in the topic's `avoid` list. Reject if the strongest of those beats the keep class by the kind's margin (default `margin`). Calibrated on the live pool, 2026-11-19.

prompts: a picture of one subject
a single character or object
one figure on its own
a picture of one scene
a wide view of a landscape, a sky or a town
a background painting of a place

sheet: a sheet of many small drawings arranged in a grid
the same character drawn many times with different expressions
a collection of many different hairstyles
a character sheet with many small figures
icons: a set of many small flat icons
a sticker sheet with many stickers
pattern: a wallpaper of many repeated small motifs

franchise._comment: Franchise / fan-art check (ADR-0003), anime and cartoon only (photos are covered by the banned-word list: cosplay, brands). Each prompt names a well-known franchise character; each decoy describes a look-alike original. Reject if the strongest franchise class beats the topic's keep class and every decoy by `margin`. Calibrated on the live pool, 2026-11-19 (see crates/ref-filters/README.md).
